newsitem.title: USA: Bid made to keep hospital in Newark, N.J. -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Bid made to keep hospital in Newark, N.J. -- paper.

text.p: New Jersey's Cathedral Healthcare System has made a bid to keep United Healthcare System's Children's Hospital in Newark, Star-Ledger reported Tuesday.
The plan involves moving the staff of Children's Hospital to Saint Michael's Medical Center in Newark.
As part of the proposal, Cathedral would also set up a residency in pediatrics at Saint Michael's for the 38 medical resident at United.
The new entity would be called Saint Michael's Children's Hospital.
The United system is $50 million in debt and seeking a buyer, the newspaper reported. Alex Brown & Sons is reviewing bids and is expected to announce this week which plan is best for Newark.
